title: The Role
author: HR Workshop Leadjbbh
excerpt: Your posture, hand gestures, and tone of voice communicate more than your words. Learn the exact executive body language cues to crack interviews.
content: 4. Controlled Speaking Pace: Under stress, the body releases adrenaline, causing candidates to speak rapidly in a high pitch. Practice pausing for one second before answering and lower your speaking register to convey executive presence.
